# spyro init

Bootstrap configuration and run toolchain audit.

## Before you run it

Creates a spyro.toml in the current directory and checks ssh/scp are installed. Refuses if a spyro.toml already exists up the tree. Does not contact servers.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro init`

```text
Usage: spyro init [OPTIONS]

  Bootstrap configuration and run toolchain audit.

Options:
  --skip-deps  Skip dependency audit
  --help       Show this message and exit.
```
